questions.question: The statement- “We shall die to awaken the nation” was made by _______.
questions.solution: Bagha Jatin (Jatin Mukherjee) made this famous statement. He was a revolutionary leader of the Jugantar party.

questions.question: Rabindranath Tagore started Santiniketan institute in _______.
questions.solution: 1901 is when Rabindranath Tagore founded Santiniketan in West Bengal, which later became Visva-Bharati University.

questions.question: Which king was shown on his coins as a Veena player?
questions.solution: Samudragupta is shown playing the Veena on his gold coins, indicating his love for music and arts. He is called the 'Napoleon of India'.

questions.question: Shiv Dayal Saheb, a banker from Agra, founded the Radha Soami Satsang in _______.
questions.solution: <u>1861</u> was the founding year of the Radha Soami movement in Agra by Shiv Dayal Singh (Soami Ji Maharaj).

questions.question: The British Parliament passed the Regulating Act in _____.
questions.solution: <u>1773</u> was when the Regulating Act was passed to establish parliamentary control over the East India Company.

questions.question: The Airavatesvara Temple in Tamil Nadu was built by ______.
questions.solution: Rajaraja Chola II built the Airavatesvara Temple at Darasuram. It is part of the Great Living Chola Temples (UNESCO site).

questions.question: Swami Vivekananda gave his famous speech at the Parliament of World Religions in Chicago in_________.
questions.solution: 1893 is the year Swami Vivekananda delivered his historic address beginning with 'Sisters and Brothers of America' at Chicago.

questions.question: Which Indian reformer is regarded as the "Father of Bengali Prose"?
questions.solution: <u>Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar</u> is called the 'Father of Bengali Prose' for his contribution to simplifying the Bengali alphabet and prose style.

questions.question: Which of the following places does NOT have major rock edicts of Ashoka?
questions.solution: Sanchi has major pillar edicts and stupas, but it is not a location for Ashoka's 14 Major Rock Edicts.

questions.question: Prayer halls in Buddhist architectural monuments were also known as ________
questions.solution: Chaitya grihas were the prayer halls, while Viharas were the residential quarters for Buddhist monks.

questions.question: Who established the Ramakrishna Mission?
questions.solution: Swami Vivekananda established the Ramakrishna Mission in 1897 to propagate the teachings of his guru, Ramakrishna Paramahamsa.

questions.question: Dr. B.R Ambedkar was associated with which of the following communities?
questions.solution: <u>Mahar</u> was the community Dr. B.R. Ambedkar belonged to. He fought against the social discrimination faced by this community.

questions.question: Which Lodi ruler's (1489 AD -1517 AD) real name was Nizam Khan?
questions.solution: Sikandar Lodi (reign 1489-1517) was born as Nizam Khan. City: He founded the city of Agra in 1504.

questions.question: Bhagat Singh was executed on March 23, 1931 along with __________.
questions.solution: Sukhdev and Rajguru were executed alongside Bhagat Singh in Lahore Jail for the Lahore Conspiracy Case.

questions.question: When was the Champaran Agrarian Law passed by the British Government?
questions.solution: 1918 was the year the Champaran Agrarian Law was enacted after Mahatma Gandhi's successful Satyagraha against the Tinkathia system.

questions.question: Which of the following was an ambassador of Persian ruler and was sent to Vijayanagara?
questions.solution: Abdur Razzaq was the Persian ambassador who visited the court of Devaraya II of the Vijayanagara Empire.

questions.question: Which freedom fighter is known as the mother of the Indian revolution?
questions.solution: Madam Bhikaji Cama is known as the 'Mother of Indian Revolution'. Fact: She unfurled the first Indian flag on foreign soil (Germany, 1907).

questions.question: Which famous ruler was known as the "Second Ashoka"?
questions.solution: Kanishka is known as the 'Second Ashoka' for his patronage of Buddhism and organizing the Fourth Buddhist Council.

questions.question: Who among the following led the Chittagong Armoury Raid?
questions.solution: Surya Sen (popularly known as Masterda) led the daring Chittagong Armoury Raid in 1930 against the British.

questions.question: Which Turkish invader attacked and raided the temple of Somnath in 1025 AD?
questions.solution: <u>Mahmud Ghazni</u> attacked the Somnath Temple in Gujarat in 1025 AD during his 16th expedition to India.

questions.question: Nadir Shah, ruler of Iran plundered the city of Delhi in __________.
questions.solution: 1739 is the year Nadir Shah invaded India, defeated the Mughals at the Battle of Karnal, and looted the Peacock Throne.

questions.question: In which year was All-India Muslim League formed?
questions.solution: 1906 was the formation year of the Muslim League. Objective: To protect the political rights of Muslims in India.

questions.question: The Brihadisvara temple at Tanjavur was constructed by ________.
questions.solution: <u>Rajaraja I</u> (Rajaraja Chola I) built the Brihadisvara Temple (Peruvudaiyar Kovil) in Tanjavur, dedicated to Lord Shiva.

questions.question: The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was founded in_______.
questions.solution: 1928 is when the HSRA was founded at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi. Leaders: Chandra Shekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev.

questions.question: The grading system used by the Mughals to fix rank, salary and military responsibilities is called ____________.
questions.solution: Mansabdari system was the grading system where 'Mansab' designated rank. Zat determined rank/salary, and Sawar determined cavalry requirements.
